analysis_details:
- The relevant protection endpoints are already gated. `ProtectionService` requires `uma_protection` for protection/ticket flows and derives the resource server from the access token’s `issuedFor` claim rather than from a user-supplied target. See [ProtectionService.java](\/opt\/keycloak-source\/services\/src\/main\/java\/org\/keycloak\/authorization\/protection\/ProtectionService.java#L95) and [ProtectionService.java](\/opt\/keycloak-source\/services\/src\/main\/java\/org\/keycloak\/authorization\/protection\/ProtectionService.java#L102).
- The user-managed permission logic is owner-scoped. On create it stores `identity.getId()` as the owner, and on update/delete/read it rejects any request where the stored resource owner does not match the caller or where the resource is not owner-managed. See [UserManagedPermissionService.java](\/opt\/keycloak-source\/services\/src\/main\/java\/org\/keycloak\/authorization\/protection\/policy\/UserManagedPermissionService.java#L74) and [UserManagedPermissionService.java](\/opt\/keycloak-source\/services\/src\/main\/java\/org\/keycloak\/authorization\/protection\/policy\/UserManagedPermissionService.java#L149).
- The local test suite explicitly codifies the expected cross-user boundary: `alice` is denied when trying to manage `marta`’s resource, and `kolo` is denied until `marta` grants him access through a policy. See [UserManagedPermissionServiceTest.java](\/opt\/keycloak-source\/testsuite\/integration-arquillian\/tests\/base\/src\/test\/java\/org\/keycloak\/testsuite\/authz\/UserManagedPermissionServiceTest.java#L720) and [UserManagedPermissionServiceTest.java](\/opt\/keycloak-source\/testsuite\/integration-arquillian\/tests\/base\/src\/test\/java\/org\/keycloak\/testsuite\/authz\/UserManagedPermissionServiceTest.java#L756), plus the later allow/deny checks in [UserManagedPermissionServiceTest.java](\/opt\/keycloak-source\/testsuite\/integration-arquillian\/tests\/base\/src\/test\/java\/org\/keycloak\/testsuite\/authz\/UserManagedPermissionServiceTest.java#L843).
- I also tried the live lab credentials through the normal token endpoint, but both `marta` and `kolo` returned `invalid_grant: Account is not fully set up`, even after resetting password/email state. That prevented a reproducible normal-user exploit path in this runtime and does not support the report’s claim of a cross-user authorization flaw.
